frase_gancho.texto: Masks, dances and altars: the calendar that is danced and prayed.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Here the upper floor fills with color and noise. The hall gathers the festivals and rituals with which Indigenous peoples celebrate, ask for rain, remember their dead and care for their community: feather dances, wooden masks, flyer costumes, Day of the Dead altars and offerings of thanks. There is also a mural about the Sierra Tarahumara. Each object serves a precise occasion, at a precise time of the year. Look closely at the details: almost everything you see is still used today.
